<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 10.2 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>LIMITED PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>OF </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>HNET OPERATING
PARTNERSHIP, L.P. </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>February&nbsp;2, 2026 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">THE UNDERSIGNED are executing this Limited Partnership Agreement (this &#8220;<U>Agreement</U>&#8221;) pursuant to the
provisions of the Delaware Revised Uniform Limited Partnership Act, 6 <U>Del.</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;C.</U> <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">&#167;&#167;&nbsp;17-101</FONT> <U>et</U> <U>seq.</U> (the &#8220;<U>Act</U>&#8221;), and do hereby certify and
agree as follows: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">1.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><U>Name</U>. The name of the limited partnership whose business shall be conducted pursuant to this
Agreement shall be HNET Operating Partnership, L.P., or such other name as the General Partner (as defined below) may from time to time hereafter designate (the &#8220;<U>Partnership</U>&#8221;). </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">2.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><U>Definitions</U>. In addition to terms otherwise defined herein, the following terms are used herein as
defined below: </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">&#8220;<U>event of withdrawal of the General Partner</U>&#8221; means an
event that caused the General Partner to cease to be a general partner of the Partnership as provided in <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Section&nbsp;17-402</FONT> of the Act. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">&#8220;<U>General Partner</U>&#8221; means HPS Net Lease Income REIT, a Maryland statutory trust, and all other
persons or entities admitted as additional or substitute general partners pursuant to this Agreement, so long as they remain general partners of the Partnership. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">&#8220;<U>Initial Limited Partner</U>&#8221; means HNET SLP, L.P., acting in its capacity as such. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">&#8220;<U>Limited Partners</U>&#8221; means the Initial Limited Partner, and all other persons or entities
admitted as additional or substitute limited partners pursuant to this Agreement, so long as they remain limited partners of the Partnership. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="justify">&#8220;<U>Partners</U>&#8221; means those persons or entities that from time to time are the General Partner
and the Limited Partners. </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">3.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><U>Purpose</U>. The purpose of the Partnership shall be, directly or indirectly through subsidiaries or
affiliates, to engage in any lawful act or activity for which limited partnerships may be formed under the Act and engage in any and all activities necessary or incidental to the foregoing and to engage in such other activities as are necessary,
incidental or ancillary thereto as the General Partner shall deem necessary or advisable. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
</DIV></Center>

Limited Partners being separately designated, are as set forth on <U>Schedule A</U> attached hereto. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

Partnership of the Partnership in accordance with the Act and shall continue until dissolution of the Partnership in accordance with Section&nbsp;14 of this Agreement. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">7.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><U>Management of the Partnership</U>. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">The General Partner shall have the sole and exclusive right to manage, control and conduct the business and
affairs of the Partnership, and shall have all powers and rights necessary, appropriate or advisable to effectuate and carry out the purposes and business of the Partnership and, in general, all powers permitted to be exercised by a general partner
under the Act. The General Partner may appoint, employ, or otherwise contract with any persons or entities for the transaction of the business and affairs of the Partnership or the performance of services for or on behalf of the Partnership, and the
General Partner may delegate to any such person or entity such authority to act on behalf of the Partnership as the General Partner may from time to time deem appropriate. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">No Limited Partner, in its capacity as such, shall have the right to take part in the management or control
of the business or affairs of the Partnership or any authority to act for or bind the Partnership or otherwise to transact any business on behalf of the Partnership. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><U>Capital Contributions</U>. Partners have made such contributions to the Partnership, if any, as are set
forth in the books and records of the Partnership. No Partner is required to make any additional capital contribution to the Partnership. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">2 </P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><U>Assignments of Partnership Interest</U>. No Limited Partner may sell, assign, pledge or otherwise
transfer or encumber (collectively &#8220;<U>transfer</U>&#8221;) all or any part of its interest in the Partnership, nor shall any Limited Partner have the power to substitute a transferee in its place as a substitute Limited Partner, without, in
either event, having obtained the prior written consent of the General Partner, which consent may be given or withheld in its sole discretion. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">10.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><U>Withdrawal</U>. No Limited Partner shall have the right to withdraw from the Partnership except with the
consent of the General Partner and upon such terms and conditions as may be specifically agreed between the General Partner and the withdrawing Limited Partner. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">11.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><U>Additional Limited Partners</U>. The General Partner shall have the right to admit additional Limited
Partners upon such terms and conditions, at such time or times, and for such capital contributions as shall be determined by the General Partner. In connection with any such admission, the General Partner shall have the right to amend <U>Schedule
A</U> hereof to reflect the name and address of the admitted Limited Partner. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">12.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><U>Allocations and Distributions</U>. Distributions of cash or other assets of the Partnership shall be made
at such times and in such amounts as the General Partner may determine. Distributions shall be made to (and profits and losses shall be allocated among) Partners <I>pro rata</I> in accordance with the amounts of their capital contributions as set
forth in the books and records of the Partnership. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">13.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><U>Return of Capital</U>. No Partner has the right to receive, and the General Partner has absolute
discretion to make, any distributions to a Partner which include a return of all or any part of such Partner&#8217;s capital contribution; <I>provided</I>, that upon the dissolution of the Partnership, the assets of the Partnership shall be
distributed as provided in <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Section&nbsp;17-804</FONT> of the Act. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">14.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><U>Dissolution</U>. The Partnership shall be dissolved and its affairs wound up and terminated upon the
first to occur of the following: </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(a)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">The determination of the General Partner to dissolve the Partnership; or </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(b)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify">The occurrence of (i)&nbsp;an event of withdrawal of the General Partner or (ii)&nbsp;any other event
causing a dissolution of the Partnership under <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Section&nbsp;17-801</FONT> of the Act; <I>provided</I>, <I>however</I>, that the Partnership shall not be dissolved or required to be wound up upon an event of
withdrawal of the General Partner described in Section&nbsp;14(b)(i) hereof if (A)&nbsp;at the time of the occurrence of such event of withdrawal there is at least one remaining general partner of the Partnership that carries on the business of the
Partnership (any remaining general partner being hereby authorized to carry on the business of the Partnership), or (B)&nbsp;within ninety (90)&nbsp;days after the occurrence of such event of withdrawal, all remaining Partners agree in writing to
continue the business of the Partnership and to the appointment, effective as of the date of the event of withdrawal, of one (1)&nbsp;or more additional general partners of the Partnership. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">3 </P>

<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">

<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">15.</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><U>Indemnification and Exculpation</U>. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(a)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><U>Indemnification</U>. The Partnership shall indemnify and hold harmless the General Partner and its
affiliates (excluding the Partnership), and the officers, managers, directors, employees, partners, shareholders, members and (to the extent specifically agreed by the General Partner) agents of any of the foregoing, and the officers, managers,
directors, employees, partners, shareholders, members and (to the extent specifically agreed by the General Partner) agents of the Partnership (each, an &#8220;<U>Indemnitee</U>&#8221;), to the fullest extent permitted by law from and against any
and all losses, claims, demands, costs, damages, liabilities, expenses of any nature (including costs of investigation and attorneys&#8217; fees and disbursements), judgments, fines, settlements and other amounts, of any nature whatever, known or
unknown, liquidated or unliquidated (collectively, &#8220;<U>Liabilities</U>&#8221;) arising from any and all claims, demands, actions, suits or proceedings, whether civil, criminal, administrative or investigative (collectively,
&#8220;<U>Actions</U>&#8221;), in which the Indemnitee may be involved, or threatened to be involved as a party or otherwise, relating to the performance or nonperformance of any act concerning the activities of the Partnership, including acting as
a director or the equivalent of any entity during the period of time in which the Partnership holds an interest therein, or the performance by such Indemnitee of any of the General Partner&#8217;s responsibilities hereunder, unless (i)&nbsp;the act
or failure to act of the Indemnitee was not in good faith or not in a manner it believed to be in, or not contrary to, the best interests of the Partnership, or (ii)&nbsp;the Indemnitee&#8217;s conduct constituted Malfeasance (as defined below). The
termination of an Action by judgment, order, settlement or upon a plea of <I>nolo contendere</I> or its equivalent will not, in and of itself, create a presumption or otherwise constitute evidence that the Indemnitee is not entitled to
indemnification hereunder; <I>provided</I>,<I> </I>that a final, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-appealable</FONT> judgment or order adverse to the Indemnitee expressly covering the indemnification exceptions set forth in clauses (i)&nbsp;or
(ii) above may constitute evidence that the Indemnitee is not so entitled to indemnification. &#8220;<U>Malfeasance</U>&#8221; means, with respect to any Indemnitee, any act or omission which results in a criminal conviction of such Indemnitee or
which constitutes intentional fraud, willful misconduct, gross negligence or a material breach of a material term of this Agreement. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(b)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="justify"><U>Exculpation</U>. To the fullest extent permitted by law, an Indemnitee will be liable to the Partnership
or to any other Limited Partner for any losses sustained or liabilities incurred as a result of any act or omission taken or suffered by such Indemnitee only if (i)&nbsp;the act or failure to act of such Indemnitee was not in good faith or not in a
manner it believed to be in, or not contrary to, the best interests of the Partnership, or (ii)&nbsp;the Indemnitee&#8217;s conduct constituted Malfeasance. The termination of an Action by judgment, order, settlement or upon a plea of <I>nolo
c</I><I>ontendere</I> or its equivalent will not, in and of itself, create a presumption or otherwise constitute evidence that such Indemnitee is not entitled to exculpation hereunder; <I>provided</I>,<I> </I>that a final, <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-appealable</FONT> judgment or order adverse to such Indemnitee expressly covering the exculpation exceptions set forth in clauses (i)&nbsp;or (ii) above may constitute evidence that such Indemnitee is not so entitled
to exculpation. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">4 </P>

</DIV></Center>

to execute, deliver and file the Certificate of Limited Partnership of the Partnership (and any amendments or restatements thereof) and any applications necessary for the Partnership to qualify to do business in any jurisdiction.
